name: Shinagawa
tagline: Shinagawa in 1 minute and Tokyo in 10 minutes. Served by 6 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where JR East and Keikyu run 6 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 26 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 1 minute to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 3.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.6 m to 16.9 m, a difference of 14.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 5 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 8 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 地域医療機能推進機構東京高輪病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 河野臨牀医学研究所附属第三北品川病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 6 lines serve the station. JR Tokaido Line and JR Yamanote Line run through it. JR Yokosuka Line and Narita Express also call here. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line and Keikyu Main Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 5 lines and Keikyu runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Tokaido Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 川崎→品川, which includes this station. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 大井町→品川, which includes this station. JR Yokosuka Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 武蔵小杉→西大井, which this station is not on. Narita Express is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥370,000 to ¥380,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Kitashinagawa, but Shinagawa is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shinagawa. One-room rents run about ¥10,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shinagawa, but Takanawa-Gateway is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shinagawa. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 higher.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: 6 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
